import { 
  MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial, 
  MeshStandardNodeMaterial, 
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial 
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { mix, uv, vec3 } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, BoxGeometry, Shape, ExtrudeGeometry, DirectionalLight, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  // Root container
  const root = new Group();

  // Active GSAP timelines to kill on cleanup
  const activeTimelines = [];

  // --- PALETTE & CONFIG ---
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    background: "#0b0b10",
    surface: "#16161d",
    ink: "#16161d",
    paper: "#e8ecf2",
    accent: "#ff2a38"
  };

  // --- STAGE BACKDROP (Defeats FLAT_VOID) ---
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(8, 7);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  // Vertical gradient matching spec gradientStops
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec3(0.06, 0.06, 0.08), // #111116
    vec3(0.10, 0.10, 0.13), // #1a1a22
    uv().y
  );
  const backdrop = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  root.add(backdrop);

  // --- LOCAL LIGHTS (Engineered Product Lighting) ---
  const keyLight = new DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
  keyLight.position.set(2, 3, 4);
  root.add(keyLight);

  const rimLight = new DirectionalLight(new Color(colors.accent), 0.9);
  rimLight.position.set(-3, -2, -1);
  root.add(rimLight);

  // --- BEVELED PANEL ---
  // Create rounded rectangle shape
  const panelW = 3.4;
  const panelH = 1.9;
  const r = 0.06;
  const shape = new Shape();
  shape.moveTo(-panelW/2 + r, -panelH/2);
  shape.lineTo(panelW/2 - r, -panelH/2);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(panelW/2, -panelH/2, panelW/2, -panelH/2 + r);
  shape.lineTo(panelW/2, panelH/2 - r);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(panelW/2, panelH/2, panelW/2 - r, panelH/2);
  shape.lineTo(-panelW/2 + r, panelH/2);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-panelW/2, panelH/2, -panelW/2, panelH/2 - r);
  shape.lineTo(-panelW/2, -panelH/2 + r);
  shape.quadraticCurveTo(-panelW/2, -panelH/2, -panelW/2 + r, -panelH/2);

  const extrudeSettings = {
    depth: 0.04,
    bevelEnabled: true,
    bevelSegments: 4,
    steps: 1,
    bevelSize: 0.008,
    bevelThickness: 0.008
  };

  const panelGeo = new ExtrudeGeometry(shape, extrudeSettings);
  const panelMat = new MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial({
    roughness: 0.6,
    metalness: 0.2,
    clearcoat: 0.1,
    clearcoatRoughness: 0.2
  });
  // Vertical engineered gradient for the panel surface
  panelMat.colorNode = mix(
    vec3(0.06, 0.06, 0.08), // #111116
    vec3(0.10, 0.10, 0.13), // #1a1a22
    uv().y
  );

  const panel = new Mesh(panelGeo, panelMat);
  panel.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  root.add(panel);

  // --- HAIRLINE BORDER (#26262f) ---
  const borderShape = new Shape();
  const br = r + 0.006;
  const bW = panelW + 0.012;
  const bH = panelH + 0.012;
  borderShape.moveTo(-bW/2 + br, -bH/2);
  borderShape.lineTo(bW/2 - br, -bH/2);
  borderShape.quadraticCurveTo(bW/2, -bH/2, bW/2, -bH/2 + br);
  borderShape.lineTo(bW/2, bH/2 - br);
  borderShape.quadraticCurveTo(bW/2, bH/2, bW/2 - br, bH/2);
  borderShape.lineTo(-bW/2 + br, bH/2);
  borderShape.quadraticCurveTo(-bW/2, bH/2, -bW/2, bH/2 - br);
  borderShape.lineTo(-bW/2, -bH/2 + br);
  borderShape.quadraticCurveTo(-bW/2, -bH/2, -bW/2 + br, -bH/2);

  const borderGeo = new ExtrudeGeometry(borderShape, {
    ...extrudeSettings,
    depth: 0.038
  });
  const borderMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: '#26262f',
    roughness: 0.4,
    metalness: 0.5
  });
  const border = new Mesh(borderGeo, borderMat);
  border.position.set(0, 0, -0.002);
  root.add(border);

  // --- CONTENT GROUP (Floats translationZ +0.03) ---
  const contentGroup = new Group();
  contentGroup.position.set(0, 0, 0.05 + 0.03);
  root.add(contentGroup);

  // Parse Text Items
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const quoteMarkCopy = textItems.find(i => i.role === 'quote-mark')?.text ?? '“';
  const quoteCopy = textItems.find(i => i.role === 'quote')?.text ?? "The bezel action alone is worth the wait. Nothing else on my wrist feels this considered.";
  const attributionCopy = textItems.find(i => i.role === 'attribution')?.text ?? "M. OKAFOR";
  const captionCopy = textItems.find(i => i.role === 'caption')?.text ?? "COLLECTOR SINCE 2019";

  // Position Anchors (aligned with 0.25 offset rhythm)
  const leftAlignX = -1.2;
  const topY = 0.45;

  // 1. Oversized quotation mark
  const quoteMarkText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(quoteMarkCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.62,
    color: colors.accent,
    align: 'left'
  });
  // Extra pivot wrap for custom quote mark scale bounce animation
  const quoteMarkPivot = new Group();
  quoteMarkPivot.position.set(leftAlignX, topY, 0);
  quoteMarkPivot.add(quoteMarkText);
  contentGroup.add(quoteMarkPivot);

  // 2. Quote body text (max measure 2.4 units, baseline aligned)
  const quoteText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(quoteCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.17, // Adjusted visual spec to match scale beautifully
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left',
    maxWidthPx: 250 // Custom wrap width mapping to ~2.4 scene units
  });
  quoteText.position.set(leftAlignX, topY - 0.5, 0);
  contentGroup.add(quoteText);

  // 3. Attribution Rule (0.2w x 0.02h, emissive red)
  const ruleGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.2, 0.015);
  const ruleMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: colors.accent,
    emissive: colors.accent,
    emissiveIntensity: 1.4
  });
  const rule = new Mesh(ruleGeo, ruleMat);
  rule.position.set(leftAlignX + 0.1, topY - 1.1, 0);
  contentGroup.add(rule);

  // 4. Attribution Identity Row
  const attText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(attributionCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.12,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  attText.position.set(leftAlignX, topY - 1.25, 0);
  contentGroup.add(attText);

  // 5. Caption Row
  const capText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(captionCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.08,
    color: '#8b8b94', // Muted paper caption color
    align: 'left'
  });
  capText.position.set(leftAlignX, topY - 1.42, 0);
  contentGroup.add(capText);

  // --- INTRO REVEAL SEQUENCER ---
  // Apply visual-spec motion rules
  panel.position.y += 0.2;
  panelMat.opacity = 0;
  borderMat.opacity = 0;
  contentGroup.position.y += 0.2;

  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.to([panel.position, contentGroup.position], {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: "cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94)"
  }, 0);

  tl.to([panelMat, borderMat], {
    opacity: 1,
    duration: 0.5,
    ease: "power2.out"
  }, 0);

  // Weighted settle on Quote Mark (scale 1.04 -> 1.0)
  quoteMarkPivot.scale.set(1.06, 1.06, 1.06);
  tl.to(quoteMarkPivot.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: "cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1)"
  }, 0.35);

  activeTimelines.push(tl);

  // Apply cinematic primitives (if any provided later)
  if (config.cinematicPrimitives) {
    config.cinematicPrimitives.forEach((prim) => {
      if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
        const result = ctx.primitives[prim.name](root, prim.params);
        if (result && result.cleanup) {
          root.userData.customPrimitiveCleanup = result.cleanup;
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // --- CLEANUP ---
  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    activeTimelines.forEach(t => t.kill());
    panelGeo.dispose();
    panelMat.dispose();
    borderGeo.dispose();
    borderMat.dispose();
    backdropGeo.dispose();
    backdropMat.dispose();
    ruleGeo.dispose();
    ruleMat.dispose();
    if (root.userData.customPrimitiveCleanup) {
      root.userData.customPrimitiveCleanup();
    }
  };

  return root;
}
